chunks: So We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob and gave his progeny prophethood and scripture, and rewarded him in this world, and in the next he will be among the upright.

key_terms.وَيَعْقُوبَ: Jacob, son of Ibrahim and grandson of Ibrahim

ai.seo_question: What specific blessings did Allah bestow upon Prophet Ibrahim regarding his progeny and status?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is pivotal for establishing the continuity of prophethood through Ibrahim's lineage, specifically linking the Imams to the covenant of prophethood and the Quran. The phrase 'gave him his reward in the world' is often interpreted by scholars as referring to the worldly authority and leadership (Imamate) granted to the Ahl al-Bayt, while 'among the righteous' confirms their spiritual purity in the Hereafter. This dual reward underscores the unique status of the Prophet's progeny as both political and spiritual guides.
